review.why: The PR removes the 404 response when a user does not exist, changing the behavior from returning a 404 error to returning an empty list with 200 OK for non-existent user IDs.

findings.label: regression
findings.why: The PR removes the explicit User existence check (db.session.get(User, id) or abort(404)) and now returns 200 with empty list for non-existent user IDs instead of 404.

findings.label: regression
findings.why: The PR removes the explicit User existence check (db.session.get(User, id) or abort(404)) and now returns 200 with empty list for non-existent user IDs instead of 404.

doppel_guided.summary: The optimization removes the 404 for missing users, changing the API contract from 'user must exist' to 'return empty list for any user_id'.
